```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)
D = L.ROOT / "resources" / "tools"
```

Notes written while the tools were installed and tried on the machine of the published run (13 November 2026). The
tools themselves are not in the repository; [Reproduce](reproduce.qmd) lists the ones the pipeline uses.

## Overview table

From [`resources/tools/manifest.json`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/resources/tools/manifest.json).

```{python}
m = pd.DataFrame(json.loads((D / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
L.dt(m[["tool", "version", "status", "licence", "url", "blocker", "how_to_run", "notes"]], page=25,
     wrap=["tool", "version", "licence", "blocker", "how_to_run", "notes"], hide=["how_to_run", "notes"])
```
